item.title: Mathilde Gremaud Outscores Eileen Gu to Take Olympic Slopestyle Gold
item.description: Mathilde Gremaud successfully defended her Olympic slopestyle gold, scoring 86.96 to deny Eileen Gu for the second straight Winter Games. The post Mathilde Gremaud Outscores Eileen Gu to Take Olympic Slopestyle Gold appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: US Speed Skater Erin Jackson Chases History at the 2026 Winter Olympics
item.description: After making Olympic history with her 500-meter gold medal in 2022, US speed skater Erin Jackson will join teammate Brittany Bowe in the 1,000-meter race on Monday. The post US Speed Skater Erin Jackson Chases History at the 2026 Winter Olympics appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: Stefania Constantini Lifts Italy Over Team USA, Advances to Olympic Curling Semifinals
item.description: Stefania Constantini secured a 7-6 victory over Team USA on Monday, advancing Italy to the mixed doubles curling semi-finals. The post Stefania Constantini Lifts Italy Over Team USA, Advances to Olympic Curling Semifinals appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: Emily Fischnaller Returns to Winter Olympics 7 Years After Breaking Neck in Luge Crash
item.description: Emily Fischnaller is competing at her third Winter Games this week, after the US luge star broke her neck and back in a 2018 Olympic crash. The post Emily Fischnaller Returns to Winter Olympics 7 Years After Breaking Neck in Luge Crash appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: Lindsey Vonn Crash Overshadows Breezy Johnson’s Olympic Downhill Gold
item.description: Breezy Johnson earned the USA's first gold medal at the 2026 Olympics, while medical staff airlifted injured Lindsey Vonn off the slopes. The post Lindsey Vonn Crash Overshadows Breezy Johnson’s Olympic Downhill Gold appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: UCLA Women’s Basketball Survives Michigan to Extend Big Ten Lead
item.description: A tough 69-66 victory over No. 8 Michigan has No. 2 UCLA reigning over the 2025/26 Big Ten women's basketball standings. The post UCLA Women’s Basketball Survives Michigan to Extend Big Ten Lead appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: USA Hockey Tops Finland to Open 2026 Winter Olympics on 2-0 Record
item.description: Team USA is owning the hockey scoresheet at the 2026 Winter Olympics, adding a 5-0 victory over Finland to their tally on Saturday. The post USA Hockey Tops Finland to Open 2026 Winter Olympics on 2-0 Record appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: Report: WNBA Delivers New CBA Proposal After 6-Week Wait
item.description: According to ESPN, the WNBA sent a new CBA proposal to the WNBPA on Friday, more than six weeks after the players union's last counteroffer. The post Report: WNBA Delivers New CBA Proposal After 6-Week Wait appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: Emma Raducanu Retires from Qatar Open Days After Transylvania Open Exit
item.description: Emma Raducanu exited her opening match against Camila Osorio in Doha, two days after losing the Transylvania Open final to Sorana Cirstea. The post Emma Raducanu Retires from Qatar Open Days After Transylvania Open Exit appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: Speed Skater Jutta Leerdam Wins 1,000-meter Gold with Record-Breaking Olympics Run
item.description: Jutta Leerdam made Olympics history on Monday, winning gold in the women's 1,000-meter speed skating event with a record time of 1:12.31. The post Speed Skater Jutta Leerdam Wins 1,000-meter Gold with Record-Breaking Olympics Run appeared first on Just Women's Sports.
